comment: Copy to sources.json and edit. Ordered job sources. Reliability: feed/ats/html need no login; browser needs a browser tool and is best-effort. remoteFilter is per-source: 'worldwide' sources are dropped unless the role is remote-worldwide; 'any' sources (local boards) are kept regardless. locale describes where the jobs are based. Substitute {query} in searchUrlTemplate using roleSearchTerms below.

sources.name: remotive
sources.notes: Public JSON API. Filter by title/keywords against configured roles.

sources.name: remoteok
sources.notes: Public JSON. First array element is metadata; skip it.

sources.name: greenhouse-boards
sources.notes: Use the JSON API for a discovered company's Greenhouse slug.

sources.name: example-local-board
sources.notes: Replace with a regional board relevant to you. Fetch the search page(s), then open each listing for the JD and application method.

sources.name: example-browser-board
sources.searchInstructions: Use the site's search box for each role in roleSearchTerms, open each result for the JD and application method, and resolve category IDs at runtime.
sources.notes: Example JS-heavy local board; replace with your own. Needs a browser tool.

sources.name: linkedin
sources.notes: f_WT=2 = remote. Anti-bot; log 'blocked' if caught. Never solve a CAPTCHA.
